Messages.Author: Sacha
Messages.Body:
I first would like to apologise for asking a question that I should
know the answer to , but need a response as a matter of record to
appease my play group.

The situation is that My preditor has the Maddness Net in play and
attempts to bleed me at the end of my turn.

Can I play reation cards on my turn such as Tellepathic Counter,
Deflecton and Wake with Evenings freshness?

Pc.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>I first would like to apologise for asking a question that I should
>know the answer to , but need a response as a matter of record to
>appease my play group.

It's okay. I see this question come up a lot. Even recently,a fairly
experienced player in my playgroup was under the same impression as you.

>The situation is that My preditor has the Maddness Net in play and
>attempts to bleed me at the end of my turn.
>
>Can I play reation cards on my turn such as Tellepathic Counter,
>Deflecton and Wake with Evenings freshness?

Yes. What determines who can play action modifiers and who can play reactions
is based on the controller of the acting minion (and who the action is directed
against). Whose actual turn it is is irrelevant. So if you bleed me during my
turn with the Network, you can play stealth cards and bleed modifiers but I can
also play intercept cards and Deflect the bleed. Once again, action modifiers
and reaction cards are just concerned with who the acting Methusaleh is.

On the other hand, Out-of-Turn Masters do care whose turn it is. So if you
bleed me during my turn with the Network, I can't play Archon Investigation or
Direct Intervention your Conditioning, etc.

Halcyan 2

On 25 Nov 2002 13:51:22 -0800, paul...@hotmail.com (Sacha) wrote:

>I first would like to apologise for asking a question that I should
>know the answer to , but need a response as a matter of record to
>appease my play group.

This is covered by section 3.9 of the FAQ, here:

http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

>The situation is that My preditor has the Maddness Net in play and
>attempts to bleed me at the end of my turn.

>Can I play reation cards on my turn such as Tellepathic Counter,
>Deflecton and Wake with Evenings freshness?

Yes.

------------------------------

3.9. How does Madness Network work?

Madness Network allows Malkavians to take actions during other
players' minion phases. It doesn't change any of the rules regarding
those actions, though.

The acting minion can play an action card [1.6.3.1] and action
modifiers [1.6.3.2].

Reaction cards can be played by ready untapped minions in response to
"an action taken by another Methuselah's minion" [1.6.3.5]

So if a Malkavian acts during another Methuselah's minion phase, the
Predator and Prey of the Malkavian may still attempt to block. All
minions not belonging to the Malkavian's Methuselah may react to the
Malkavian's action including the Methuselah whose actual turn it is.

Only Methuselahs can play master cards, and they can play out-of-turn
masters only "during another player's turn" [1.6.2.3]
